text:
jen: heads up — cluster us-west1 has ~30 pods stuck Pending with nodeSelector gpu=true and annotation anchor=true. noticed after the autoscaler bump.

kai: saw that, thanks. any evictions/logs? can you paste `kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep Pending | head -n 10` ?

jen: ```
ml-pod-42   Pending   0/4 nodes   0   10m   <none>   gpu=true,anchor=true
ml-pod-43   Pending   0/4 nodes   0   9m
ml-pod-44   Pending   0/4 nodes   0   8m
``` 

sam: are these requesting fractional GPUs or whole GPUs? IIRC anchor=true was our soft-alloc for tiny-gang experiments.

jen: they request 0.25 nvidia.com/gpu (we've been testing fractional packing). scheduler-bot: detected preempt-loop for pods with anchor taint in us-west1b at 2023-11-03T17:45Z :warning:

kai: hmm scheduler might be treating anchor taints as strict. that would block packing and also prevent preemption of the tiny pods.

sam: can you share recent scheduler logs from one of the kube-scheduler pods? `kubectl -n kube-system logs scheduler-0 | tail -n 50` should show bind attempts.

jen: pasted excerpt: ```I1103 17:40:21.123 kube-scheduler bind failed for ml-pod-42: node affinity mismatch (anchor taint) I1103 17:41:03.456 scheduler: attemptPreempt returned no victims -> skipping``` looks like preempt returned empty victims because anchor policy excluded them.

kai: that matches a regression in the tiny-gang placement PR — fallback preempt policy was toggled off for tainted anchors. we need to re-enable soft-preempt for anchor class.

ops-robot: Created incident INC-20231103-anchordeadlock, linked dashboard https://grafana.internal/redwood/cluster/pack_us-west1

sam: plan: (1) flip scheduler config flag enableSoftPreemptForAnchors=true on canary schedulers in us-west1b, (2) drain and restart scheduler-0 if canary looks good, (3) run small canary deploy for 5 pods. I'll take ownership.

jen: I'll run the canary checks and confirm pods transition to Running. ping me when you've flipped the flag.

sam: flipping flag on canary now. will post results in 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

scheduler-bot: config change applied to scheduler-canary-us-west1b, rollout id=rc-1732

sam: canary results: 5/5 moved to Running within 90s. scaling remaining Pending pods now.

jen: looks stable, evictions dropped, GPU utilization normalized. closing INC-20231103-anchordeadlock once metrics back to baseline.

kai: follow-up: create a test in the scheduler e2e that verifies preempt fallback with anchor taints to avoid regression. assigned to @sam.

sam: noted, will open PR for e2e and add telemetry alert for anchor preempt failures.

jen: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
